name: WebGPU Gaussian Splatting Rasterization
definition: A rendering technique that maps 3D Gaussian splats to standard rasterization by converting each Gaussian into a flat rectangle (quad) facing the camera, then drawing these quads with a fragment shader. This avoids compute shaders used in the original implementation to improve performance on WebGPU.
summary: WebGPU Gaussian Splatting Rasterization renders 3D Gaussians as screen-space quads using standard triangle rasterization, avoiding compute shaders to achieve substantially better framerates.
